compaction.line-relevance.description: Select which compacted output lines a developer needs to diagnose what happened. Option keys for relevant_lines are line IDs of the form L000 generated at call time, capped at 255 per request; each option description is null because the tagged line text is already in state. Thresholds are placeholders pending shadow-mode calibration against jevkit's own run history and must not be treated as validated.

relevant_lines.instructions: Which line of the output would a developer need in order to diagnose what happened?

has_failure.instructions: Does the output contain a diagnosable failure?

compaction.disposition.v1.description: Classify bounded, redacted diagnostic tool output. Jev selects an outcome and disposition from closed sets; it never summarizes or generates output.

outcome.instructions: Classify the observed tool outcome only.

disposition.instructions: Choose how to retain existing evidence without summarizing it.

graph.router-confidence.description: Route a request to an allowed graph target when confidence is high enough. Option keys for target are populated at call time from the router node's allowedTargets. Thresholds are placeholders pending shadow-mode calibration against jevkit's own run history and must not be treated as validated.

target.instructions: Which allowed target should receive this request?

sufficiently_specified.instructions: Is the request specific enough to route without further investigation?

graph.failure-class.description: Classify a graph-stage failure into one of the known GRAPH_FAILURE_KNOWN_CLASSES. Thresholds are placeholders pending shadow-mode calibration against jevkit's own run history and must not be treated as validated.

failure_class.instructions: Which known failure class best describes this graph-stage failure?

criteria.transient-runtime: Transient runtime interruption such as timeout, rate limit, network, or session drop.
criteria.agent-correctable: Agent-correctable completion failure such as missing artifacts or verification failure.
criteria.operator-permission: Operator permission or approval is required before the run can continue.
criteria.plan-contract: Plan or graph contract violation such as undeclared path or write-scope mismatch.
criteria.terminal-configuration: Terminal configuration error such as auth, model, schema, or MCP init failure.
criteria.integrity: Integrity or sandbox violation such as symlink escape or control-path breach.
criteria.cancelled: Run was cancelled, interrupted, or stopped by signal.
criteria.unknown: Unclassified failure when no structured or text evidence maps to a known class.

graph.lane-ownership.description: Assign ownership of a repair finding to a candidate repair lane. Option keys for owner are populated at call time from candidate repair lane IDs. Thresholds are placeholders pending shadow-mode calibration against jevkit's own run history and must not be treated as validated.

owner.instructions: Which candidate repair lane owns this finding?

developer.change-risk.description: Decision support only: score the overall risk of a code change reaching production, from low to critical. Expects state.diffSummary and state.affectedAreas; state.testOutput, state.environment and state.constraints sharpen the rating when available. Thresholds are placeholders pending shadow-mode calibration and must not be treated as validated.

risk.instructions: Rate the overall risk of this change reaching production, from low to critical, based on the diff summary, affected areas, and any test output, environment or constraints provided in state.
criteria: low - isolated change, small blast radius, strong test coverage, easily reverted
moderate - contained change with reasonable coverage and limited blast radius
high - touches shared or critical-path code, or has notable coverage gaps
severe - broad blast radius, weak verification, or hard to reverse without mitigation
critical - could plausibly cause an outage, data loss, or security exposure

developer.failure-triage.description: Decision support only: classify a test/build failure's most likely root-cause category. Expects state.testOutput; state.diffSummary and state.environment sharpen the classification when available. Thresholds are placeholders pending shadow-mode calibration and must not be treated as validated.

cause.instructions: Classify the most likely root-cause category of this failure given the test/build output and any diff summary or environment provided in state.

criteria.regression: Previously passing behavior now fails; the diff plausibly introduced the defect.
criteria.dependency-toolchain: Failure traces to a dependency version, build tool, or toolchain issue unrelated to the diff's own logic.
criteria.configuration-environment: Failure traces to environment or configuration differences (missing env var, wrong runtime version, infra) rather than code logic.
criteria.test-defect-flake: The test itself is flaky, order-dependent, or incorrectly asserts; the production code is likely fine.
criteria.unknown: No structured or text evidence maps confidently to one of the above categories.

developer.test-priority.description: Decision support only: decide how much testing a change needs before merge. Expects state.diffSummary; state.affectedAreas, state.testOutput, state.environment and state.constraints sharpen the decision when available. Thresholds are placeholders pending shadow-mode calibration and must not be treated as validated.

priority.instructions: Given the diff summary, affected areas, and any test output, environment or constraints in state, decide how much testing this change needs before merge.

criteria.block: Do not merge until failing or missing tests are addressed; current evidence is insufficient or contradicts the change.
criteria.targeted-tests: Run tests scoped to the affected areas before merge; full-suite coverage is not required.
criteria.full-suite: Run the full test suite before merge; the change's blast radius or risk is not well contained.
criteria.no-additional-tests: Existing coverage is sufficient; no additional test run is needed before merge.

developer.review-disposition.description: Decision support only: decide the review disposition for a change. Expects state.diffSummary; state.affectedAreas, state.testOutput, state.environment and state.constraints sharpen the decision when available. Thresholds are placeholders pending shadow-mode calibration and must not be treated as validated.

disposition.instructions: Given the diff summary and any affected areas, test output, environment or constraints in state, decide the review disposition for this change.

criteria.block: The change must not proceed; it has a disqualifying defect, risk, or policy violation.
criteria.needs-review: A human reviewer should look at this change before it proceeds.
criteria.informational: Notable but non-blocking; surface it to a human without requiring action.

developer.release-readiness.description: Decision support only: decide whether a change is ready to release. Expects state.testOutput and state.constraints; state.diffSummary, state.affectedAreas and state.environment sharpen the decision when available. Thresholds are placeholders pending shadow-mode calibration and must not be treated as validated.

ready.instructions: Given test output and any stated release constraints, diff summary, affected areas or environment in state, decide whether this change is ready to release.

criteria.true: All required tests pass, stated release constraints and environment checks are satisfied, and no blocking review or risk finding remains outstanding.
criteria.false: Tests are failing or missing, a stated constraint or environment check is unmet, or a blocking finding remains outstanding.

policy.fallback: not ready - escalate to human release owner
